category_descriptions.Analyst: Company-level analyst questionnaires, submitted answers, request status, ownership, and as-of history for research workflows.
category_descriptions.BDC Holdings: Reported BDC portfolio investments linked to issuers and securities, with filing dates, currencies, valuations, industries, and FactSet identifiers.
category_descriptions.Beta Estimation: Security beta estimates built from prices, yields, spreads, duration, weekly excess returns, and market benchmarks such as Treasuries, SPY, loan TRS, and CDX HY.
category_descriptions.Bond Features: Analysis-ready bond characteristics including issuer, coupon, maturity, rating, seniority, security, price, OAS, yield, duration, and forward-return features.
category_descriptions.Bond Issuers: Bond issuer and corporate hierarchy records covering parents, ultimate parents, domicile, country of risk, company identifiers, and ticker relationships.
category_descriptions.Bond Securities: Bond terms and identifiers including coupon structure, maturity, currency, collateral, issue size, amount outstanding, minimum piece, and market classification.
category_descriptions.Bond Trades: Aggregated bond execution and markout measures including side, quantity, counterparty type, transaction cost, immediate profit, trade count, and electronic-trading probability.
category_descriptions.Bonds: Primary-market and reference data for expected and priced bond deals, tranches, borrowers, terms, ratings, syndicate activity, and outstanding securities.
category_descriptions.Broker Research: Unstructured sell-side and independent research ingested into the Argus wiki, organized by sending provider with document counts, formats, coverage windows, and recency.
category_descriptions.CreditSights: CreditSights loan covenant analysis, including covenant headroom, restricted-payment capacity, add-backs, documentation protections, and index-level comparison scores.
category_descriptions.Dealogic: Debt-capital-markets transactions from Dealogic, with deal and tranche identifiers, issuers, parent companies, announcement, pricing, settlement, banks, and ranking eligibility.
category_descriptions.Debt Features: Modeled debt-security features combining amount outstanding, coupon, maturity, duration, spread, yield, beta, liquidity, industry, and subsequent-return measures.
category_descriptions.Direct Lending: Private-credit borrowers and facilities with funded and unfunded exposure, terms, pricing, financial performance, sponsor, and portfolio ownership.
category_descriptions.Equity: Equity securities and options with issuer, price, return, volatility, delta, scenario, industry, and portfolio-exposure measures.
category_descriptions.FactSet: FactSet feeds spanning debt capital structures, entity hierarchies, filings, ownership, estimates, fundamentals, security identifiers, fund data, and market reference content.
category_descriptions.Funds: Fund definitions and analytics covering structure, type, manager, strategy, currency, commitments, performance, holdings, and portfolio characteristics across Apollo and vendor sources.
category_descriptions.Futures: Exchange-traded futures specifications and observations covering contract codes, expiries, multipliers, tick values, currencies, prices, volumes, and underlying markets.
category_descriptions.General: Unclassified production assets spanning new-issue monitoring, research ingestion, operational mappings, and vendor feeds; use provider and schema context while taxonomy is refined.
category_descriptions.Holdings: Security- and issuer-level holdings by fund and reporting date, including quantity, market value, cost, exposure, ownership percentage, and portfolio classifications.
category_descriptions.Index: Index constituents and analytics including weights, market value, returns, spreads, yields, ratings, sectors, regressions, and index-level summary measures.
category_descriptions.Instruments: Cross-asset instrument reference records linking identifiers, security types, issuers, currencies, terms, related instruments, and source-system classifications.
category_descriptions.Issuers: Issuer master and cross-reference data linking Apollo, Bloomberg, WSO, S&P, and vendor identifiers with names, parents, industries, countries, and match quality.
category_descriptions.JPM: JPMorgan loan and credit-index feeds, query definitions, identifiers, facility and issuer attributes, ratings, spreads, and data-quality controls.
category_descriptions.Macro: Haver economic databases and time series with series definitions, frequencies, units, observation dates, values, vintages, and ingestion lineage.
category_descriptions.Market Data: Observed security and index levels including prices, yields, spreads, returns, market values, ratings, coupons, maturities, and constituent classifications.
category_descriptions.Markit: Markit credit data for CDS entities, curves, index tranches, constituents, obligations, events, pricing, liquidity, and reference obligations.
category_descriptions.Metadata: Operational metadata used to restore and govern field definitions, tags, data types, table mappings, and generated schema-alteration statements.
category_descriptions.Options: Option reference codes and derivative datasets describing option type, strike, expiry, underlying, premium, volatility, delta, and scenario outcomes.
category_descriptions.Power BI: Curated report datasets covering risk, PnL, beta, debt, direct lending, equity, indexes, JPM loan analytics, PFOF, government spending, and shared filter dimensions.
category_descriptions.PnL: Position-level profit and loss with alpha, beta, rates, carry, currency, attribution, returns, issuer, security, fund, strategy, and purchase-date context.
category_descriptions.PnL Chat Context: Compact fund- and asset-level PnL context prepared for natural-language analysis, including alpha, beta, rates, carry, return, contribution, issuer, and strategy measures.
category_descriptions.Portfolio: Fund, portfolio, and position records with holdings, quantities, cost, market value, NAV, cash flows, strategy, investor, currency, and look-through analytics.
category_descriptions.Positions: Current and historical investment positions with fund, issuer, security, quantity, cost, market value, rating, strategy, scenario PnL, and reporting classifications.
category_descriptions.Pricing: Apollo price and financial-statement observations with company, financial item, actual or estimate status, value, unit, as-of date, workbook source, and knowledge date.
category_descriptions.Productivity: Industry productivity time series combining employment, hours, earnings, compensation, real and nominal output, price indexes, and output-per-worker growth.
category_descriptions.Quality: Data-monitoring results for field completeness and distribution drift, including null rates, distinctness, deltas, stability indexes, distance tests, slices, and comparison windows.
category_descriptions.Rates: Interest-rate futures specifications and market observations with Bloomberg identifiers, contract dates, named metrics, relative labels, and values by as-of date.
category_descriptions.Reference Data: Crosswalks among CUSIP, ISIN, Bloomberg, Apollo, and vendor identifiers with security descriptions, series, maturity type, coupon, and related-instrument relationships.
category_descriptions.Risk: Position and instrument risk across funds and strategies, including notional, market value, duration, spread, delta, option terms, ratings, industries, and scenario sensitivities.
category_descriptions.Risk / PnL: Joined risk and PnL views aligning fund, strategy, issuer, security, rating, geography, exposure, return, and attribution on a common as-of date.
category_descriptions.SDR / Trades: Regulatory derivatives records and derived positions for CDX, tranches, and options, including trade dates, notional, product, strike, expiry, premium, price, and implied volatility.
category_descriptions.SDR CDX: Public SDR credit-index transactions normalized by UPI, index, expiry, factor, price or spread, notional, currency, platform, and block-trade indicators.
category_descriptions.SDR CDX Options: Public SDR credit-index option transactions with UPI, underlying index, strike, option type, expiry, premium, notional, currency, platform, and execution flags.
category_descriptions.Scenarios: Scenario risk results by fund, strategy, issuer, and security, with scenario names, dates, positions, market value, and shocked risk or PnL measures.
category_descriptions.Securities: Security-level history and analytics for identifiers, prices, coupons, duration, yields, spreads, benchmarks, attributes, frequencies, and source observations.
category_descriptions.Security: Loan and private-credit security records covering bank deals, contracts, rates, base rates, spreads, prices, amounts, amortization schedules, and source-system audit fields.
category_descriptions.Semi Analysis: SemiAnalysis research on AI demand, hyperscalers, chips, power requirements, and data-center supply by company, location, period, unit, category, and region.
category_descriptions.TRACE: FINRA TRACE bond transactions and portfolio markouts, including execution date and time, side, quantity, price, yield, spread, flags, and portfolio-relative measures.
category_descriptions.Trading: Orders, fills, tickets, trade metrics, cash movements, and audit records with fund, product, side, quantity, price, market value, currency, sector, and trade date.
